sightings.name: Unless
sightings.text: Reported by one ship, which described a harbour called Kindling, a mountain called Old Grudge, and a sea serpent in more detail than seemed necessary. It is drawn here on the understanding that it exists, unless it doesn’t.

sightings.name: Lull
sightings.text: Reported by a ship that lay becalmed off its coast for a week with nothing to do but draw it, which is why the chart is so careful. Nobody has found it since. The wind keeps picking up.
